bridge: Bridge $50-$150 of a stablecoin into {chain} with {name} and leave the funds on the destination chain for 30 days (fee $1-$5, 15 min).
Bridge a second $50 amount back a week later, so the address shows two-way use (fee $1-$5, 15 min).
Use {name} to move $50 to {chain2} as well, and hold the funds there for 30 days (fee $2-$6, 15 min).
Repeat one bridge a week for four weeks, varying the amount between $25 and $100 (fees $1-$5 a week, 15 min/week).
Keep a small balance on the destination chain for 60 days instead of bridging it all back (no extra cost, 5 min/week).
cex: Finish identity verification on {name} and deposit $100-$300, then leave a balance for 30 days (no deposit fee on most rails, 30 min).
Make two spot trades of $50-$100 each on {name}, a week apart, from the same account (fees $0.10-$0.50 per trade, 10 min each).
Hold $50 of the traded asset on {name} for 60 days instead of withdrawing (free, 5 min/week).
Try one more {name} product, such as an earn or savings product, with $50, 30 days (no extra fee, 15 min).
Keep the account active with one trade a month for three months and log each trade (fees under $1 a month, 10 min a month).
chain: Bridge $50-$150 onto {chain} and make at least one transaction a week there for four weeks (fees $0.50-$3 a week, 10 min/week).
Use two different apps on {chain} from the same wallet, for example a swap and a deposit, with $25-$50 each (fees $1-$4, 20 min).
Hold a $50 balance on {chain} for 60 days without moving it to another chain (free, 5 min/week).
Try a {name} app on {chain}: $50 deposit, hold 30 days (fees $1-$5, 15 min).
Vote in one on-chain governance proposal on {chain} if {name} opens a vote, and keep the receipt (fees $0.50-$2, 10 min).
dex: Swap $50-$200 of tokens on {name} on {chain} in two separate trades a week apart (gas $1-$5 per trade, 10 min each).
Provide $100-$300 of liquidity to a {name} pool on {chain} and keep it in for 30+ days (gas $3-$10, 15 min).
Trade on {name} on {chain2} as well, one $50 swap, so the address is active on two chains (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
Collect the liquidity fees after 30 days and re-add half of them to the same pool (gas $3-$8, 15 min).
Make one trade a week on {name} for four weeks, varying the token pair each time (about $2-$6 of gas per week, 10 min/week).
lending: Supply $100-$500 of USDC or ETH as collateral in {name} on {chain} (gas $2-$8, 10 min). Leave the position open for 30+ days without withdrawing.
Borrow a small amount against the collateral, under 30% of its value, and repay it within two weeks (interest a few dollars, 15 min).
Repeat one supply and one borrow each week for a month so the address shows steady use (about $5-$15 of gas per week, 15 min/week).
Open the same position in {name} on {chain2}: $50, hold 30 days (gas $3-$10, 15 min).
Hold the supplied position through the next 60 days without closing it, and check weekly (gas only, 5 min/week).
risk: Deposit $100-$500 into a {name} curated vault on {chain} and leave it for 30+ days (gas $3-$10, 15 min).
Read the vault curator's strategy note and pick the vault whose risk note matches a 30-day hold (free, 20 min).
Add $50 to the same vault in week three to show repeated use (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
Open a second vault position in {name} on {chain2} with $50, hold 30 days (gas $3-$8, 15 min).
Keep the vault positions open for 60 days, check the curator's reports weekly, and claim rewards after 30 days (gas $2-$6, 5 min/week).
rwa: Buy $100-$300 of a tokenised real-world asset on {name} on {chain} and hold it for 30+ days (gas $3-$10, 15 min).
Complete any identity check {name} asks for before buying, and keep the account details ready (no fee for the check itself, 20-30 min).
Add a second $50 purchase in week three from the same wallet (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
Try the same product on {chain2} with a $50 purchase and hold it for 30 days (gas $3-$8, 15 min).
Hold both positions for 60 days and collect any yield the asset pays, re-investing half (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
stake: Stake $100-$300 of the chain's native asset through {name} on {chain} and leave it staked for 30+ days (gas $2-$8, 15 min).
Keep the staking receipt token in the same wallet for the whole period instead of selling (free, 5 min/week to check).
Stake a further $50 in week three from the same wallet (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
Use the receipt token once in a {name} partner pool on {chain2} with $50, hold 30 days (gas $3-$8, 15 min).
Unstake only after 60 days, and claim staking rewards after 30 days (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
yield: Deposit $100-$300 into a {name} vault on {chain} and leave it earning for 30+ days (gas $3-$10, 15 min).
Claim the vault yield after 30 days and re-deposit half of it (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
Deposit a second, smaller amount of $50 into {name} on {chain2} and hold it for 30 days (gas $3-$8, 15 min).
Top up the first vault by $50 in week three, so the address shows repeated deposits (gas $2-$6, 10 min).
Keep the position open for 60 days and record each deposit and claim in a notebook, checking the vault weekly (gas only, 5 min/week).
